verses.en: Who is as the wise man? and who knoweth the interpretation of a thing? a man’s wisdom maketh his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.
verses.pt: Quem é como o sábio? e quem sabe a interpretação das coisas? A sabedoria do homem faz brilhar o seu rosto, e com ela a dureza do seu rosto se transforma.
verses.en_web: Who is like the wise man? And who knows the interpretation of a thing? A man’s wisdom makes his face shine, and the hardness of his face is changed.
verses.en_bbe: Who is like the wise man? and to whom is the sense of anything clear? A man's wisdom makes his face shining, and his hard face will be changed.

verses.en: I counsel thee to keep the king’s commandment, and that in regard of the oath of God.
verses.pt: Eu digo: Observa o mandamento do rei, e isso por causa do juramento a Deus.
verses.en_web: I say, “Keep the king’s command!” because of the oath to God.
verses.en_bbe: I say to you, Keep the king's law, from respect for the oath of God.

verses.en: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.
verses.pt: Não te apresses a sair da presença dele; nem persistas em alguma coisa má; porque ele faz tudo o que lhe agrada.
verses.en_web: Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,
verses.en_bbe: Be not quick to go from before him. Be not fixed in an evil design, because he does whatever is pleasing to him.

verses.en: Where the word of a king is, there is power: and who may say unto him, What doest thou?
verses.pt: Porque a palavra do rei é suprema; e quem lhe dirá: que fazes?
verses.en_web: for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”
verses.en_bbe: The word of a king has authority; and who may say to him, What is this you are doing?

verses.en: Whoso keepeth the commandment shall feel no evil thing: and a wise man’s heart discerneth both time and judgment.
verses.pt: Quem guardar o mandamento não experimentará nenhum mal; e o coração do sábio discernirá o tempo e o juízo.
verses.en_web: Whoever keeps the commandment shall not come to harm, and his wise heart will know the time and procedure.
verses.en_bbe: Whoever keeps the law will come to no evil: and a wise man's heart has knowledge of time and of decision.

verses.en: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man is great upon him.
verses.pt: Porque para todo propósito há tempo e juízo; porquanto a miséria do homem pesa sobre ele.
verses.en_web: For there is a time and procedure for every purpose, although the misery of man is heavy on him.
verses.en_bbe: For every purpose there is a time and a decision, because the sorrow of man is great in him.

verses.en: For he knoweth not that which shall be: for who can tell him when it shall be?
verses.pt: Porque não sabe o que há de suceder; pois quem lho dará a entender como há de ser?
verses.en_web: For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?
verses.en_bbe: No one is certain what is to be, and who is able to say to him when it will be?

verses.en: There is no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither hath he power in the day of death: and there is no discharge in that war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
verses.pt: Nenhum homem há que tenha domínio sobre o espírito, para o reter; nem que tenha poder sobre o dia da morte; nem há licença em tempo de guerra; nem tampouco a impiedade livrará aquele que a ela está entregue.
verses.en_web: There is no man who has power over the spirit to contain the spirit; neither does he have power over the day of death. There is no discharge in war; neither shall wickedness deliver those who practice it.
verses.en_bbe: No man has authority over the wind, to keep the wind; or is ruler over the day of his death. In war no man's time is free, and evil will not keep the sinner safe.

verses.en: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: there is a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.
verses.pt: Tudo isto tenho observado enquanto aplicava o meu coração a toda obra que se faz debaixo do sol; tempo há em que um homem tem domínio sobre outro homem para o seu próprio dano.
verses.en_web: All this I have seen, and applied my mind to every work that is done under the sun. There is a time in which one man has power over another to his hurt.
verses.en_bbe: All this have I seen, and have given my heart to all the work which is done under the sun: there is a time when man has power over man for his destruction.

verses.en: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this is also vanity.
verses.pt: Vi também os ímpios sepultados, os que antes entravam e saíam do lugar santo; e foram esquecidos na cidade onde haviam assim procedido; também isso é vaidade.
verses.en_web: So I saw the wicked buried. Indeed they came also from holiness. They went and were forgotten in the city where they did this. This also is vanity.
verses.en_bbe: And then I saw evil men put to rest, taken even from the holy place; and they went about and were praised in the town because of what they had done. This again is to no purpose.

verses.en: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
verses.pt: Porquanto não se executa logo o juízo sobre a má obra, o coração dos filhos dos homens está inteiramente disposto para praticar o mal.
verses.en_web: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
verses.en_bbe: Because punishment for an evil work comes not quickly, the minds of the sons of men are fully given to doing evil.

verses.en: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his days be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:
verses.pt: Ainda que o pecador faça o mal cem vezes, e os dias se lhe prolonguem, contudo eu sei com certeza que bem sucede aos que temem a Deus, porque temem diante dele;
verses.en_web: Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who fear God, who are reverent before him.
verses.en_bbe: Though a sinner does evil a hundred times and his life is long, I am certain that it will be well for those who go in fear of God and are in fear before him.

verses.en: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
verses.pt: ao ímpio, porém, não irá bem, e ele não prolongará os seus dias, que são como a sombra; porque ele não teme diante de Deus.
verses.en_web: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow; because he doesn’t fear God.
verses.en_bbe: But it will not be well for the evil-doer; he will not make his days long like a shade, because he has no fear before God.

verses.en: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just men, unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked men, to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also is vanity.
verses.pt: Ainda há outra vaidade que se faz sobre a terra: há justos a quem sucede segundo as obras dos ímpios, e há ímpios a quem sucede segundo as obras dos justos. Eu disse que também isso é vaidade.
verses.en_web: There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked. Again, there are wicked men to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also is vanity.
verses.en_bbe: There is a thing which is to no purpose done on the earth: that there are good men to whom is given the same punishment as those who are evil, and there are evil men who get the reward of the good. I say that this again is to no purpose.

verses.en: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.
verses.pt: Exalto, pois, a alegria, porquanto o homem nenhuma coisa melhor tem debaixo do sol do que comer, beber e alegrar-se; porque isso o acompanhará no seu trabalho nos dias da sua vida que Deus lhe dá debaixo do sol.
verses.en_web: Then I commended mirth, because a man has no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be joyful: for that will accompany him in his labor all the days of his life which God has given him under the sun.
verses.en_bbe: So I gave praise to joy, because there is nothing better for a man to do under the sun than to take meat and drink and be happy; for that will be with him in his work all the days of his life which God gives him under the sun.

verses.en: When I applied mine heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done upon the earth: (for also there is that neither day nor night seeth sleep with his eyes:)
verses.pt: Quando apliquei o meu coração a conhecer a sabedoria, e a ver o trabalho que se faz sobre a terra (pois homens há que nem de dia nem de noite conseguem dar sono aos seus olhos),
verses.en_web: When I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth (for also there is that neither day nor night sees sleep with his eyes),
verses.en_bbe: When I gave my mind to the knowledge of wisdom and to seeing the business which is done on the earth (and there are those whose eyes see not sleep by day or by night),

verses.en: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek it out, yet he shall not find it; yea further; though a wise man think to know it, yet shall he not be able to find it.
verses.pt: então contemplei toda obra de Deus, e vi que o homem não pode compreender a obra que se faz debaixo do sol; pois por mais que o homem trabalhe para a descobrir, não a achará; embora o sábio queira conhecê-la, nem por isso a poderá compreender.
verses.en_web: then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man labors to seek it out, yet he won’t find it. Yes even though a wise man thinks he can comprehend it, he won’t be able to find it.
verses.en_bbe: Then I saw all the work of God, and that man may not get knowledge of the work which is done under the sun; because, if a man gives hard work to the search he will not get knowledge, and even if the wise man seems to be coming to the end of his search, still he will be without knowledge.
